$comment: The AiGovOps estate — every property the interaction crawler audits. The aggregator (estate-interaction-crawl.yml) loops this list; the monitor (docs/estate-health.html) renders the result. Add a property by adding a row. failOnDead=true makes a dead button fail that property's own run; gated=true means the public surface needs a session (crawled read-only until an auth recipe is wired).

sites.name: Library (rendered)
sites.note: Opened with the one-click consent cookie (omni_rules=1) — no account, no payment, no secret. Was `gated` and therefore never crawled; the first run behind the door found five CORS-blocked API calls that had been dead for members since the membership wall went up.

sites.name: Open Source v4
sites.note: Crawl switched on at the move. Nothing had ever watched this property, so nobody could say whether it served; the hourly crawl is now the thing that answers that, and if the Pages site is not actually live the board goes red within the hour. That is the intended outcome — an unwatched property is the worse state.
